implementation.admission: Reserve exact Vec capacity+128 before full packet allocation. Fixed framing credit covers bounded scanner/stack/bookkeeping. Rejected packets drain while locating top-level id/op anywhere in the frame,without a complete Value/string/body temporary. Unknown small envelopes can stage in either pool;final lane transfers the same backing allocation,charges the new owner before returning old credit,and cannot retain control credit for data.
implementation.parser: Reuse tested4x UTF8 +768/token including keys+64KiB conservative estimate before serde Value parsing. Raw and parser reservations overlap through parse;raw releases before dispatch. Parsed Value drops before its lease;transferred Viz metadata admission is declared before the receiving request owner so Values die before those leases. Estimates/requested-layout evidence are not allocator usable-size/RSS.
implementation.isolation: Complete malformed JSON/UTF8/unpairedUTF16/depth/header failures return INVALID_REQUEST with a bounded recoverable id. Quota returns INPUT_BUDGET_PRESSURE,budget=rust-rpc-input. The next frame is still usable and Mapper/snapshots unchanged. An incomplete length/body is an unrecoverable transport EOF;no guessed resynchronization. LoneUTF16 is rejected in isolation,not advertised as supported text.
implementation.control: Separate reserved admission for known small controls,including op after arguments. Data cannot pin control credit. resourceBudget.rpcInput reports both pools and readiness. A single stdin byte FIFO and serial handler remain;this does not overtake a half-read frame or a running map. Control denied counts reservation attempts,so a successful data fallback may increment the provisional-control denied counter.
